> **🚀 New feature: scraping trial reels, one of Instagram's newest features**. Trial reels let creators test a video with non-followers before sharing it with their main audience, and Instagram Reel Scraper can now pull them alongside regular reels, or skip them for cleaner results. [More info](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper#how-to-scrape-trial-reels). ## What can Instagram Reel Scraper do? Instagram Reel Scraper **extracts data from public Instagram reels** beyond what the Instagram API provides. Add one or multiple Instagram usernames, profile URLs, or profile IDs, and you can: 🎥 Get **detailed stats for the latest reels**, including likes, shares, comments, views, plays, and timestamps 🧩 Extract **metadata about each reel**, such as captions, transcripts, hashtags, pinned status, paid partnership, co-authors, music and location data, and 10 latest comments with metrics 🌐 Analyze **hashtags, mentions, and tagged users** to track trends or identify collaborations 👀 **Download reel media**, including videos and images, and extract video transcripts ⬇️ Export reel data in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML** 📆 Use the **date range filter or skip pinned reels** to pre-filter your data before extraction 🦾 Access the data programmatically via SDKs (Python & Node.js), API endpoints, and webhooks 🤳 Explore our other [social media scrapers](https://apify.com/store/collections/instagram-scrapers) Add Instagram Reel Scraper to your short-form video performance toolkit to help you out with **influencer research, campaign tracking, competition monitoring, and content auditing.** ## What data can I scrape from Instagram Reels? Instagram Reel Scraper can extract every key detail from a reel, including:
🎥 Reel ID 🔗 Reel URL 🧑‍🎤 Owner username 👤 Owner full name
❤️ Likes count 🔄 Shares count 💬 Comments count 👁️ Video views and play count
🏷️ Hashtags 📢 Mentions 👤 Tagged users 📎 Product type
✍️ Video transcript 🕒 Timestamp 📝 Caption 💬 Latest comments (10) with replies, likes, and timestamps
📽️ Downloaded video URL and original video URL ⏱️ Video duration (seconds) 🎶 Music info (artist, song, original audio) 🖼️ Images (thumbnails or sidecar frames)
📌 Is sponsored? ❌ Are comments disabled? 👥 Co-author producers 📊 Media dimensions (height & width)
**Example:** For a NASA Reel from September 2025, Instagram Reel Scraper extracted: - Reel caption, mentions, and URL - 161k likes, 2.2k comments, 1.1M views - Video duration (98 seconds), video URL, and downloaded video URL - Display images (thumbnails), transcript, and tagged users - Music information, including original audio - Latest comments with timestamps, likes, and any replies > Tip: For **popular reels discovery and reels research** (rather than targeted reels scraping), use the `scrape reels` option in the 🔗 [Instagram Hashtag Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-hashtag-scraper). You’ll find Reels related to your chosen hashtag, along with their details and authors. ## How to scrape Instagram Reels? 1. [Create](https://console.apify.com/) a free Apify account. 2. Open [Instagram Reel Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper). 3. Add **one or multiple Instagram usernames, profile URLs, or profile IDs or reel URLs**. 4. Click **"Save & Start"** and wait for the datasets to be generated. 5. Download your data in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML**, or access it via API. If you want more guidance on how to use Instagram Reel Scraper, here's a tutorial on [How to scrape reels](https://blog.apify.com/scrape-instagram-reels/) and a full video that shadows it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qQDtmXC1Ijw > If you would like to scrape not only reels data but also all their comments — go for our 🔗 [Instagram Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-comment-scraper). ## How much will scraping Instagram Reels cost? Instagram Reel Scraper uses a **pay-per-event (PPE)** model. On the Free plan, it costs $2.60 per 1,000 results ($0.0026 per result), giving **nearly 2,000 results for free with the $5 credit**. Paid plans offer discounted rates and more monthly credit. For example, the Starter plan charges $2.30 per 1,000 results, which allows for **over 12,600 results per month**. Check the [pricing tab](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/pricing) for full details. ## ⬇️ Input Enter either a **profile URL, Instagram username, or profile ID**. Alternatively, you can start with reel URLs themselves. You can input URLs individually or in bulk using the **Bulk edit** function. ## ⬆️ Output The results appear in a dataset in the **Storage** tab. You can view them as a table, download in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML**, or use API endpoints. Besides the table view, you can also view your data as JSON, as well as download it as CSV, XML, Excel file, or through an API. They cover almost all functionalities of the dedicated scrapers. ## ❓FAQ ### How to scrape trial reels? Trial reels are an Instagram feature that creators use to test a video with non-followers before sharing it with their existing audience. Here's how you can include or exclude trial reels from our output: - Keep trial reels (default): the feed is scraped with trial reels mixed in among regular reels. - Skip trial reels: enable the skip option, and the feed is scraped without them, which gives you cleaner, more accurate results. Trial reels aren't marked differently in the output, so you can't tell them apart from regular reels within a single run. To find out which reels are trial, scrape the same profile twice, once with trial reels and once without, then compare the two datasets. Any reel that shows up only in the "keep" run is a trial reel. Tried it out? Share your feedback in a [review](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/reviews). ### Sometimes the scraped metrics (like, comment, and view counts) don’t match with what is shown on Instagram. Why is that? If you compare a post or reel side by side with the Actor's output, the numbers can differ. There are two common reasons, and neither means the data is wrong. 1. The Actor sees the logged-out version of the page. The Actor scrapes public data, so it gets the same counts Instagram shows a visitor who isn't signed in. Instagram doesn't show logged-out visitors everything: engagement from private accounts, for example, is often hidden. That means the counts you see while logged into your own account can be higher than the ones the Actor returns. To check what the Actor should see, open the post in a private/incognito browser window. The counts there should match the Actor's output. If they do, the Actor is working correctly. 2. Counts are a snapshot from the moment of the run. Views, likes, and comments keep changing after the run finishes. A reel that returned 976 views in the morning can legitimately show 982 views when you check it in the afternoon. Always compare against the run's timestamp, not against the live page hours or days later. If the numbers still don't line up after both checks, contact support with the run ID and the post URL so we can look into it. ### Why did we introduce `downloadedVideo` URLs to download reels instead of relying on CDN-based video links? `downloadedVideo` URLs are more reliable and globally accessible, with predictable expiration (downloaded video expires after 3 days) and no IP blocks. You can choose whether to include or exclude pinned reels when scraping. Since pinned reels can sometimes be very old (and not relevant to your scrape), skipping them just makes sense sometimes. However, this option is only available in the JSON input, not in the user-facing UI. You can control it by setting it to `true`or `false`. For more details, check the [Input tab](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-post-scraper/input-schema) of the Actor. ### Can I exclude pinned reels even if they are within the date range? That’s not possible to filter out before scraping. The scraper will always include pinned reels if they match your Date filter settings. If you want to exclude them, you’ll need to filter the output data after the run by checking for `isPinned: true` and removing those items. ### Is there any way to scrape only new reels (including pinned ones) while filtering out older pinned reels? Yes, there is. You can combine the **Date filter** with **Pinned posts** parameter in JSON input. > **🚀 New feature: scraping trial reels, one of Instagram's newest features**. Trial reels let creators test a video with non-followers before sharing it with their main audience, and Instagram Reel Scraper can now pull them alongside regular reels, or skip them for cleaner results. [More info](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper#how-to-scrape-trial-reels). ## What can Instagram Reel Scraper do? Instagram Reel Scraper **extracts data from public Instagram reels** beyond what the Instagram API provides. Add one or multiple Instagram usernames, profile URLs, or profile IDs, and you can: 🎥 Get **detailed stats for the latest reels**, including likes, shares, comments, views, plays, and timestamps 🧩 Extract **metadata about each reel**, such as captions, transcripts, hashtags, pinned status, paid partnership, co-authors, music and location data, and 10 latest comments with metrics 🌐 Analyze **hashtags, mentions, and tagged users** to track trends or identify collaborations 👀 **Download reel media**, including videos and images, and extract video transcripts ⬇️ Export reel data in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML** 📆 Use the **date range filter or skip pinned reels** to pre-filter your data before extraction 🦾 Access the data programmatically via SDKs (Python & Node.js), API endpoints, and webhooks 🤳 Explore our other [social media scrapers](https://apify.com/store/collections/instagram-scrapers) Add Instagram Reel Scraper to your short-form video performance toolkit to help you out with **influencer research, campaign tracking, competition monitoring, and content auditing.** ## What data can I scrape from Instagram Reels? Instagram Reel Scraper can extract every key detail from a reel, including:
🎥 Reel ID 🔗 Reel URL 🧑‍🎤 Owner username 👤 Owner full name
❤️ Likes count 🔄 Shares count 💬 Comments count 👁️ Video views and play count
🏷️ Hashtags 📢 Mentions 👤 Tagged users 📎 Product type
✍️ Video transcript 🕒 Timestamp 📝 Caption 💬 Latest comments (10) with replies, likes, and timestamps
📽️ Downloaded video URL and original video URL ⏱️ Video duration (seconds) 🎶 Music info (artist, song, original audio) 🖼️ Images (thumbnails or sidecar frames)
📌 Is sponsored? ❌ Are comments disabled? 👥 Co-author producers 📊 Media dimensions (height & width)
**Example:** For a NASA Reel from September 2025, Instagram Reel Scraper extracted: - Reel caption, mentions, and URL - 161k likes, 2.2k comments, 1.1M views - Video duration (98 seconds), video URL, and downloaded video URL - Display images (thumbnails), transcript, and tagged users - Music information, including original audio - Latest comments with timestamps, likes, and any replies > Tip: For **popular reels discovery and reels research** (rather than targeted reels scraping), use the `scrape reels` option in the 🔗 [Instagram Hashtag Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-hashtag-scraper). You’ll find Reels related to your chosen hashtag, along with their details and authors. ## How to scrape Instagram Reels? 1. [Create](https://console.apify.com/) a free Apify account. 2. Open [Instagram Reel Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper). 3. Add **one or multiple Instagram usernames, profile URLs, or profile IDs or reel URLs**. 4. Click **"Save & Start"** and wait for the datasets to be generated. 5. Download your data in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML**, or access it via API. If you want more guidance on how to use Instagram Reel Scraper, here's a tutorial on [How to scrape reels](https://blog.apify.com/scrape-instagram-reels/) and a full video that shadows it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qQDtmXC1Ijw > If you would like to scrape not only reels data but also all their comments — go for our 🔗 [Instagram Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-comment-scraper). ## How much will scraping Instagram Reels cost? Instagram Reel Scraper uses a **pay-per-event (PPE)** model. On the Free plan, it costs $2.60 per 1,000 results ($0.0026 per result), giving **nearly 2,000 results for free with the $5 credit**. Paid plans offer discounted rates and more monthly credit. For example, the Starter plan charges $2.30 per 1,000 results, which allows for **over 12,600 results per month**. Check the [pricing tab](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/pricing) for full details. ## ⬇️ Input Enter either a **profile URL, Instagram username, or profile ID**. Alternatively, you can start with reel URLs themselves. You can input URLs individually or in bulk using the **Bulk edit** function. ## ⬆️ Output The results appear in a dataset in the **Storage** tab. You can view them as a table, download in **JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML**, or use API endpoints. Besides the table view, you can also view your data as JSON, as well as download it as CSV, XML, Excel file, or through an API. They cover almost all functionalities of the dedicated scrapers. ## ❓FAQ ### How to scrape trial reels? Trial reels are an Instagram feature that creators use to test a video with non-followers before sharing it with their existing audience. Here's how you can include or exclude trial reels from our output: - Keep trial reels (default): the feed is scraped with trial reels mixed in among regular reels. - Skip trial reels: enable the skip option, and the feed is scraped without them, which gives you cleaner, more accurate results. Trial reels aren't marked differently in the output, so you can't tell them apart from regular reels within a single run. To find out which reels are trial, scrape the same profile twice, once with trial reels and once without, then compare the two datasets. Any reel that shows up only in the "keep" run is a trial reel. Tried it out? Share your feedback in a [review](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/reviews). ### Sometimes the scraped metrics (like, comment, and view counts) don’t match with what is shown on Instagram. Why is that? If you compare a post or reel side by side with the Actor's output, the numbers can differ. There are two common reasons, and neither means the data is wrong. 1. The Actor sees the logged-out version of the page. The Actor scrapes public data, so it gets the same counts Instagram shows a visitor who isn't signed in. Instagram doesn't show logged-out visitors everything: engagement from private accounts, for example, is often hidden. That means the counts you see while logged into your own account can be higher than the ones the Actor returns. To check what the Actor should see, open the post in a private/incognito browser window. The counts there should match the Actor's output. If they do, the Actor is working correctly. 2. Counts are a snapshot from the moment of the run. Views, likes, and comments keep changing after the run finishes. A reel that returned 976 views in the morning can legitimately show 982 views when you check it in the afternoon. Always compare against the run's timestamp, not against the live page hours or days later. While CDN URLs were a cheaper option, they also expire unpredictably, are region-restricted, cause IP blocks on large runs, and sometimes separate audio from video which is not what users would want from their downloaded reels. ### Can I track reel metrics over time? Yes. Metrics like views, likes, comments, and shares are included in each scrape. You can store and track them over time to monitor performance. ### Can I scrape multiple reels at once? Yes. You can provide a list of reel URLs or an Instagram profile URL to scrape all Reels from that profile. ### Sometimes the scraped metrics (like, comment, and view counts) don’t match with what is shown on Instagram. Counts are a snapshot from the moment of the run. Views, likes, and comments keep changing after the run finishes. Always compare against the run's timestamp, not against the live page hours or days later. If the numbers still don't line up after both checks, contact support with the run ID and the post URL so we can look into it. ### Are comments included in the reels scraping? Yes, the latest 10 comments are included, along with replies, likes, and timestamps. You can also see if comments are disabled for a reel. If you want to scrape all comments from a reel, use 💬 [Instagram Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-comment-scraper). ### Can I scrape reels from private accounts? No. The scraper only works for public reels. Private reels content will not be accessible. ### Can I skip pinned reels when scraping Instagram reels? Yes. You can choose whether to include or exclude pinned reels when scraping. Since pinned reels can sometimes be very old (and not relevant to your scrape), skipping them just makes sense sometimes. However, this option is only available in the JSON input, not in the user-facing UI. You can control it by setting it to `true`or `false`. For more details, check the [Input tab](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-post-scraper/input-schema) of the Actor. ### Can I exclude pinned reels even if they are within the date range? That’s not possible to filter out before scraping. The scraper will always include pinned reels if they match your Date filter settings. If you want to exclude them, you’ll need to filter the output data after the run by checking for `isPinned: true` and removing those items. ### Is there any way to scrape only new reels (including pinned ones) while filtering out older pinned reels? Yes, there is. You can combine the **Date filter** with **Pinned posts** parameter in JSON input. If you want to see reels newer than a certain date (using the Date filter `onlyPostsNewerThan`) and also include Pinned reels only if they meet that condition, set: ```json "skipPinnedPosts": true, "onlyPostsNewerThan": "1 day" ``` With this setup: - Pinned reels that are newer than the time restriction will still be included. - Older pinned reels will be skipped. This way you’ll get the result you want: “Scrape pinned reels only if they fit the date restriction”. ### How is video data returned? Videos are returned as direct MP4 URLs. You also get all associated images for the reel in multiple resolutions. ### Is there support for original audio? Yes. You get full details on the audio, including artist, song name, and whether the original audio is used. ### Is it legal to scrape Instagram reels? Our Instagram Reel scraper only collects data that is publicly available on Instagram. It does not access private content. You should be aware that some public data may be considered personal data under regulations like the [GDPR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation). Only scrape data if you have a legitimate reason. For guidance, see our blog on [the legality of web scraping](https://blog.apify.com/is-web-scraping-legal/). ### Can I integrate Instagram Reel data with other services? Yes. You can also use [webhooks](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/webhooks) to trigger actions whenever a run finishes, like sending notifications or syncing datasets. ### Can I use the Instagram Reel Scraper with the Apify API? For Node.js, use the apify-client [NPM package](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/api/javascript). For Python, use the apify-client [PyPI package](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/api/python). Full API docs are available in the [Apify API reference](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2). ### Can I get Instagram Reel details through an MCP server? Yes. You can [connect](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/api/mcp) to an MCP server using clients like ClaudeDesktop or LibreChat, or build your own integration. For Instagram Reel Scraper: 1. The message starts the Instagram Reel Scraper with the provided input. 4. The response should be: Accepted. Learn more in [MCP setup guide](https://blog.apify.com/how-to-use-mcp/). ### Instagram Reel Scraper not working The Apify team constantly improves Actor performance. input.title: Input schema for Instagram reel scraper
input.description:
To scrape reels, enter an Instagram username or profile URL. You can also paste direct reel URLs. Then click ▶ Start and the data will be extracted. The rest of the fields are optional. If you need help, follow this video tutorial.

🎬 To extract reels that are popular for a keyword, use Instagram Search Scraper. To extract reels by hashtag, use Instagram Hashtag Scraper. If you want to scrape comments from each reel, use Instagram Comments Scraper.

username.title: 🎞️ Instagram username, profile URL, ID, or reel URL
username.description: Add Instagram usernames, profile URLs, IDs, or direct reel URLs. Each item will be processed individually.

resultsLimit.title: 💯 Maximum reels per profile
resultsLimit.description: Set how many reels should be scraped per profile. For example, if set to 5, the scraper will extract up to 5 reels from each profile. This setting is ignored when scraping direct reel URLs.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: 📅 Scrape reels newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Scrape reels from the provided date up to the present. Supported formats include `YYYY-MM-DD`, full ISO timestamps (e.g. `2025-09-23T10:02:01`), or relative time such as `1 day`, `2 weeks`, or `3 months`. All times are evaluated in UTC.
onlyPostsNewerThan.sectionDescription: Limit scraping to reels published within a specific time period.

skipPinnedPosts.title: 📌 Skip pinned reels
skipPinnedPosts.description: Enable this option if you want to exclude pinned reels from the overall results.
